snippet.title: Hydro Thunder Hurricane Official Trailer
snippet.description: Hydro Thunder Hurricane is an all new, adrenaline dripping sequel to the legendary Arcade hit!  This is the sequel Hydro Thunder fans have been waiting for! With gorgeous visuals, over-the-top themed environments and dynamic water-based racing, Hydro Thunder Hurricane is bigger, better and more beautiful than ever on XBLA.
